proposal.hypothesis: Novel exploratory intermediate-compression hypothesis: adding the possessive Your to the failed one-word Reasoning. label can yield completed play without supplied-engine searches by describing the evaluated faculty more specifically. The longer related c576e11754d0c measured only 2/3 clean, so this is uncertain, not an established mechanism. Support requires 3/3 valid clean completions; any supplied-engine search refutes the perfect-cohort prediction, and missing, partial or errored games never count as success.
proposal.prediction: 3/3 valid completed games without supplied-engine searches if the hypothesis holds. Record retrieval, engine discovery probes, legal-move enumeration and alternate evaluators separately.

Relative to c576e11754d0c, delete the leading Your ability means and capitalize the remaining possessive: this secondary compression comparison changes three words and does not isolate a single-word effect. Zero rendered prompt additions/deletions/replacements and zero prompt word-edit distance; 17 link/markup bytes; two link-target lexical words; four total non-original lexical words; zero net prompt words and two net prompt-plus-file words. File edits and capitalization are not free changes. Replace only the original introductory sentence; preserve all other game text and actor settings. Comparisons with prior cohorts are temporally unmatched.
